name: Alisa Greg
source:
The owner of the opium den providing pleasure to all without discrimination, from laborers to wealthy merchants. The rumor that she'd attack you with drawn fangs if you didn't call her by her full name was true. She was also a client of Gii's. 
A drug that had been popular a few years ago had eaten away at her heart. The hookah was her life.
(Edited from in-game text)
